source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.5 with the second Example 2.4 (PDF 33-34).

blocks.text: Gravity ke asar se azadana girta jism yaksan taur par tez hoti seedhi harkat ki sab se maanoos misal hai. Galileo ke mutabiq sab ajsam (khala mein) acceleration due to gravity ke tahat azadana girte hain, jo g se zahir hota hai aur jis ki tajurbati qeemat SI units mein 9.8 m s^-2 hai. Is ka matlab hai ke mukhtalif ajsam ek hi oonchai se girne diye jayein to ek hi velocity se zameen se takrate hain. g ke nishan ke bare mein, yeh girte jism ke liye musbat (jab ibtidai velocity sifr ho) aur seedha oopar phenke gaye jism ke liye manfi (jab ibtidai velocity sifr na ho) liya jata hai.

blocks.title: Azadana girte jism ke liye equations of motion
blocks.text: a = g rakhne par equations vf = vi + gt; S = h = vi t + (1/2) g t^2; vf^2 - vi^2 = 2gh ban jati hain.

blocks.title: Example 2.4 (doosra, jaisa chhapa)
blocks.text: 1 kg ki lohe ki gend minar se girai jati hai aur 3.34 s mein zameen par pohnchti hai. Nikalein (a) minar ki oonchai, (b) zameen se takrate waqt gend ki velocity. Hal: gend gravity ke asar se gir rahi hai, to equations mein a = g; m = 1 kg, t = 3.34 s, vi = 0, vf = ?, a = g = 9.8 m s^-2. (b) Pehli equation se vf = vi + gt = 0 + (9.8 m s^-2)(3.34 s) = 32.7 m s^-1. (a) Zameen se takrane ki velocity teesri equation ke saath oonchai dene ko istemal ho sakti hai: vf^2 - vi^2 = 2gh, (32.7 m s^-1)^2 - 0 = 2 x 9.8 m s^-2 x h, h = 1069.29 m^2 s^-2 / 19.6 m s^-2 = 54.56 m.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein (a) minar ki oonchai aur (b) zameen se takrane ki velocity poochi gayi hai, magar kitab ke hal mein velocity ko hissa (a) aur oonchai ko hissa (b) likha gaya hai. Pehle velocity nikalni parti hai kyunke oonchai usi se nikalti hai, is liye yahan hal mein velocity wala hissa (b) aur oonchai wala hissa (a) likha gaya hai, sawal ke mutabiq. Jawab wahi hain: oonchai 54.56 m aur velocity 32.7 m s^-1.

blocks.caption: g ka nishan
rows: acceleration ibtidai (oopar ki) velocity ke ulat

blocks.prompt: 14.6 m s^-1 se oopar jata helicopter zameen se 156.8 m oopar hai jab ek patthar giraya jata hai. Patthar zameen tak pohnchne mein kitna waqt leta hai (numerical problem 2.2)?
blocks.explanation: Patthar helicopter ki oopar ki velocity se shuru hota hai, to oopar musbat lein: vi = +14.6 m s^-1, a = -9.8 m s^-2, aur zameen S = -156.8 m par. Phir -156.8 = 14.6 t - 4.9 t^2, ya 4.9 t^2 - 14.6 t - 156.8 = 0, jis se t = (14.6 + sqrt(213.2 + 3073.3))/9.8 = (14.6 + 57.3)/9.8 = 7.3 s.

items: Free fall: sab ajsam g = 9.8 m s^-2 se girte hain (Galileo), ek hi oonchai se ek hi velocity se zameen par pohnchte hain; girte hue g musbat, oopar phenkne par manfi.
vf = vi + gt, h = vi t + (1/2) g t^2, vf^2 - vi^2 = 2gh. Misal: 3.34 s ki girawat 32.7 m s^-1 aur 54.56 m deti hai.
